Players Committee card image of [[Aayla Secura (Holo AI) (Errata 2)]] (errata PC-E2), game text: “Power +1 for each opponent's character here. When with two of your aliens (or clones), adds one battle destiny. May not be targeted by weapons unless each of your other aliens and clones present are 'hit.' Immune to You Are Beaten and attrition < 5.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/aaylasecura_ai.png</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/91ca80c51880e683322c125b7a0b6ec807df1ab8 91ca80c] (18 February 2021). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
